findings.evidence: 한번/천천히 입어 보세요 are both natural suggestions.
천천히/한번/같이 다시 말해 주세요 are all natural requests.
findings.fix: Applied bans for 천천히 against 한번 and 같이.

findings.evidence: 같이/한번/천천히 갈까요? are all natural suggestions.
findings.fix: Applied bans for 같이 against 한번 and 천천히.

findings.evidence: 먼저/한번/천천히 입어 보세요 are all natural.
findings.fix: Applied bans for 먼저 against 한번 and 천천히.

findings.evidence: 다시/한번 보여 주세요 are both natural requests.
이 옷/색 한번 입어 볼까요? are both natural in clothing context.
다른 색/옷도 추천해 주세요 are both natural.
직원은 먼저 입어 보세요라고 말했어요 lacks quotation marks and cannot attach 라고 directly to 보세요 as written.
findings.fix: Applied indirect-report correction to 직원은 먼저 입어 보라고 말했어요.
